text:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: hosted-api | error-rate-5m > 3% (5m window). Pager duty: pd-INC-9921. Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall.

Alex K: ack, I'm primary for this shift, looking now. paging @Sara M as secondary.

Sara M: on it, incoming. any immediate customer-facing errors?

Alex K: seeing a spike in downstream 502/500 from image-resize service, roughly 3.8% across host pool. Affected routes mainly: /v1/generate (small subset of requests). No DC-wide outage.

Lara S: support update — two paying customers reported degraded throughput but not total failures. CS is monitoring.

Nate R: quick sanity check — I can see increased latency before errors, looks like queueing on gpu-worker-34. Putting a small scale-up suggestion via autoscaler.

Alex K: doing the runbook step 1-3 now (see runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/hosted-api-errors). Will try recycling worker group and warming caches.

Sara M: good call. Also recommending we temporarily adjust alert threshold to avoid noisy pages while we mitigate. Suggest bump error-rate-5m from 3% -> 5% for 1h and add manual ticket to revert. thoughts?

Jules P: we can do that but track it in the incident ticket. If we raise threshold, we need to note SLA impact and get follow-up.

Alex K: agree. customer impact seems limited, I support a temporary threshold increase to reduce paging and let ops stabilize. Will create a PD incident note and toggle alert.

incident-bot: PD incident pd-INC-9921 created by Alex K. Incident channel: #inc-9921-hosted-api.

Alex K: switching to changed alert config now. Command I used in alerting repo:

```
# alerts/hosted-api-errors.yaml
- alert: ErrorRate5mHigh
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="hosted-api",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="hosted-api"}[5m])) > 0.05
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

(replaced 0.03 with 0.05, pushed to feature/incident-tmp, and applied in staging then prod).

Sara M: confirmed prod alert rule shows 5% now. I'll mute PD escalation for this rule for 1h as backup so we don't double page. Adding note: "temporary threshold increase during mitigation pd-INC-9921"

Jules P: please add follow-up action: 1) revert threshold, 2) postmortem clause if this recurs, 3) SLA impact note. Assign to Alex K.

Alex K: added follow-up checklist in the PD incident. Owner: Alex K. ETA revert: 2026-03-15T16:30Z (1h).

Nate R: autoscaler bumped pool +2 workers, queue drained, error rate dropping to 2.1% over last 5m. Looks like scale helped.

Lara S: CS reports errors subsided for the two customers. Good.

Sara M: re: handoff — I'm scheduled to be primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC shift but have a 30m gap at 01:00 UTC where I'm slightly delayed due to an appointment. Jules, can you cover 00:50-01:10 UTC as secondary overlap?

Jules P: I can cover that gap. I'll set a calendar override and note it in the rota.

Alex K: great. Quick note on process: changing SLO alert thresholds on-call is allowed for emergency mitigation but must follow this checklist: 1) record PD ticket, 2) publish change in incident channel, 3) schedule revert with owner, 4) file postmortem if recurring. I added that to the ticket.

Sara M: agreed. also creating a tiny runbook patch to document "temporary alert tuning" steps. snippet:

```
# runbook fragment
- step: change-alert-threshold
  cmd: opsctl alert update hosted-api ErrorRate5mHigh --threshold 0.05 --ttl 60m
  note: must create PD incident and add follow-up owner
```

Alex K: final status FYI — error rate steady ~1.8% over last 10m, workers stable. I'll keep the threshold at 5% until revert ETA, then flip back and monitor.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: revert alert threshold in 60m (trigger: pd-INC-9921).

Jules P: thanks all. Summary for handoff: Alex remains incident owner until revert; Sara will be primary at 18:00 UTC; Jules covers 00:50-01:10 UTC gap; follow-ups assigned to Alex (revert + postmortem) and Nate (investigate autoscaler config).

Alex K: noted. Closing channel update — will post a short incident summary to #postmortems once we confirm stabilization. :white_check_mark:

Sara M: thanks, team. :thumbsup:

Lara S: passing to CS that it's stable.

Nate R: logging a follow-up ticket for autoscaler tuning: TKT-4456.

Alex K: last message before handoff — I'm adding one-line in the runbook: "If temporary threshold changes are applied, annotate with PD ID and revert ETA."

Jules P: acknowledged.

Alex K: handing over to Sara for the 18:00 shift — Sara, ping me if anything spikes.

Sara M: copy that, will watch.

(End of thread)
